sections.title: THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER THE SOUTHEAST STATES
sections.text: ...SUMMARY... SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE NORTHERN AND CENTRAL GREAT PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON THROUGH THE EVENING...WITH THIS ACTIVITY SPREADING INTO THE UPPER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY AFTER DARK. A FEW STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE POSSIBLE ACROSS THE SOUTHEAST AND MID-ATLANTIC REGION DURING THE AFTERNOON.

sections.title: ND/SD/MN
sections.text: A LONG-LIVED CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS OVER CENTRAL ND HAS RESULTED IN A MID LEVEL MCV. MOST 12Z MODEL SOLUTIONS SHOW AGREEMENT IN FOCUSING CONVECTIVE RE-DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON IN VICINITY OF THIS FEATURE...WITH STORMS TRACKING SOUTHEASTWARD INTO PARTS OF EASTERN SD AND WESTERN MN. A RATHER STRONG SOUTHERLY LOW LEVEL JET IN THIS REGION AND FAVORABLE LARGE SCALE FORCING WILL SUPPORT THE RISK OF AN ORGANIZED MCS MOVING ACROSS THIS REGION...POSING A THREAT OF DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL. GIVEN THE CONSISTENCY IN THE MODEL GUIDANCE...HAVE ADDED AN ENHANCED RISK AREA FOR WIND. IT IS UNCERTAIN HOW FAR EAST THESE STORMS WILL MAINTAIN SEVERE INTENSITY DUE TO WEAKER INSTABILITY OVER MN.

sections.title: MT/ND/SD
sections.text: STRONG DAYTIME HEATING IS OCCURRING TODAY OVER MUCH OF SOUTHEAST MT...WHERE NORTHERLY UPSLOPE FLOW IS PRESENT. A SHORTWAVE TROUGH CURRENTLY OVER SOUTHWEST MT WILL APPROACH THIS REGION BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON...HELPING TO INITIATE ISOLATED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT. IT APPEARS LIKELY THAT ONE OR MORE CLUSTERS OF STORMS WILL TRACK FROM EASTERN MT INTO PARTS OF SOUTHWEST ND AND WESTERN SD THIS EVENING. MODEL SOLUTIONS DIFFER ON THE PLACEMENT AND ORGANIZATION OF THIS ACTIVITY...BUT THE POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR A BOWING COMPLEX CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL.

sections.title: SOUTHEAST STATES
sections.text: WATER VAPOR LOOP SHOWS A SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER MIDDLE TN MOVING SLOWLY EASTWARD...EMBEDDED IN SOUTHERN FRINGE OF WESTERLIES OVER THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS. DESPITE SLIGHTLY STRONGER LARGE SCALE SUPPORT FOR ORGANIZED CONVECTION TODAY...WIDESPREAD LOW/MID CLOUDS ARE PRESENT OVER MUCH OF THE CAROLINAS COMPARED TO YESTERDAY. SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE LIKELY TO FORM THROUGHOUT THIS REGION...WITH THE STRONGEST ACTIVITY CAPABLE OF LOCALLY GUSTY/DAMAGING WINDS. ..HART/COOK.. 07/16/2016

sections.title: DISCUSSION
sections.text: NO SIGNIFICANT LARGE-SCALE PROBABILITY CHANGES ARE WARRANTED THIS PERIOD.

sections.title: PLAINS
sections.text: ALTHOUGH CONSIDERABLE COMPLEXITY EXISTS ACROSS RECOVERING WARM SECTOR OVER THE NRN PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON...SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS REMAIN LIKELY ACROSS THE ENH REGION INTO THE EVENING HOURS. REMNANTS OF LONG-LIVED MCS HAVE PROGRESSED INTO CNTRL ND AND INTENSIFICATION HAS YET TO MATURE ALONG LEADING EDGE OF THIS ACTIVITY. EVEN SO...NEW UPDRAFTS SHOULD EVOLVE SEWD ALONG WARM ADVECTION CORRIDOR...LIKELY ROOTING INTO MOIST/BUOYANT AIR MASS THAT SHOULD SUPPORT ORGANIZED SEVERE. FARTHER SOUTH...CONVECTION IS GRADUALLY INCREASING WITHIN UPSLOPE ZONE ALONG THE CHEYENNE RIDGE BENEATH THICKER PLUME OF CIRRUS. STRONG HEATING ACROSS THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS SHOULD AID INTENSIFICATION AS THIS ACTIVITY SPREADS/PROPAGATES EWD. FOR THIS REASON HAVE NUDGED HIGHER SEVERE PROBS WWD IN CLOSER PROXIMITY TO INITIATING ZONE.

sections.title: DELMARVA
sections.text: 5 PERCENT PROBABILITIES HAVE BEEN EXTENDED NORTH TO ACCOUNT FOR ROBUST CONVECTION THAT HAS DEVELOPED ACROSS THE DELMARVA REGION. GUSTY WINDS ARE THE PRIMARY CONCERN WITH THESE LOCALLY STRONG STORMS. ..DARROW.. 07/16/2016 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1129 AM CDT SAT JUL 16 2016/

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND WIND DAMAGE ARE EXPECTED ACROSS PARTS OF THE NORTHERN AND CENTRAL GREAT PLAINS THIS EVENING WITH THIS ACTIVITY SPREADING EASTWARD INTO THE UPPER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY. A FEW STRONG THUNDERSTORMS WITH MARGINALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS ARE ALSO POSSIBLE ACROSS THE GULF COAST STATES AND CAROLINAS OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR SO.

sections.title: NRN PLAINS
sections.text: LATEST WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS A LOW-AMPLITUDE UPPER-LEVEL RIDGE OVER THE NRN PLAINS WITH A SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING EWD ACROSS THE NRN HIGH PLAINS. A CLUSTER OF STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ONGOING IN WRN SD IS LOCATED ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF LARGE-SCALE ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH. TO THE EAST OF THESE STORMS...AN AXIS OF MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY IS ANALYZED BY THE RAP FROM ERN NEB EXTENDING NNWWD INTO ECNTRL SD. ALTHOUGH SOME CAPPING IS LIKELY PRESENT ALONG THE WRN EDGE OF THE INSTABILITY AXIS...THE STORMS IN WRN SD SHOULD BE ABLE TO MOVE EWD TO THE INSTABILITY AXIS LATER THIS EVENING AIDED BY LARGE-SCALE ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH. STORMS MAY ALSO DEVELOP SWD INTO CNTRL NEB AS THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVES EWD. THE SRN EXTENT OF CONVECTION WOULD BE IN WRN KS WHERE MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY IS ALSO PRESENT. INCREASING LOW-LEVEL FLOW ACROSS THE CNTRL AND NRN PLAINS WILL ALSO HELP MAINTAIN A POTENTIAL FOR WIND DAMAGE AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL INTO THE EARLY MORNING HOURS. FURTHER TO THE EAST...A SMALL CLUSTER OF STORMS IS ONGOING IN SW MN AND FAR NE SD ALONG THE NERN EDGE OF MODERATE INSTABILITY. THIS ACTIVITY IS FORECAST TO MOVE SEWD AL

sections.title: GULF COAST STATES/CAROLINAS
sections.text: A VERY MOIST AIRMASS IS CURRENTLY IN PLACE FROM THE CNTRL GULF COAST STATES NEWD INTO THE CAROLINAS WHERE SFC DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE 70S F. THIS IS CONTRIBUTING TO MODERATE INSTABILITY WITH SCATTERED STRONG THUNDERSTORMS ONGOING ACROSS MUCH OF THE WARM SECTOR EARLY THIS EVENING. ALTHOUGH DEEP-LAYER SHEAR IS GENERALLY UNDER 30 KT IN THE MARGINAL RISK AREA...THE INSTABILITY AND VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER MAY BE ENOUGH FOR MARGINALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS WITH THE STRONGER MULTICELL LINE SEGMENTS FOR ANOTHER HOUR OR SO. ..BROYLES.. 07/17/2016

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN INCREASE IN STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORM COVERAGE IS EXPECTED THROUGH EARLY AFTERNOON. DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE. TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED AND A WATCH IS LIKELY PRIOR TO 19Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SMALL BOWING COMPLEX OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WAS IN PROGRESS ACROSS CENTRAL ND AT 1725Z...WHERE WEAK ELEVATED INSTABILITY /500 J/KG/...LOW-LEVEL WARM ADVECTION...AND ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH A PRONOUNCED MCV WERE CONTRIBUTING TO OBSERVED STORM INTENSITY. AN ISOLATED STRONG/OCCASIONALLY SEVERE STORM WAS ALSO LOCATED OVER DEWEY COUNTY SD...ALONG THE SOUTHERN FRINGE OF ASCENT WITH THE ND MCV. DESPITE AREAS OF MID/HIGH-LEVEL CLOUDS...DIURNAL HEATING AND LOWER 60S SURFACE DEW POINTS SHOULD RESULT IN MODERATE SURFACE-BASED INSTABILITY BY MID AFTERNOON. WESTERLY MID-LEVEL FLOW OF 30-35 KTS WILL CONTRIBUTE TO EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR ON THE ORDER OF 40-45 KTS ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA. AN INCREASE IN THUNDERSTORM COVERAGE IS ANTICIPATED DURING THE AFTERNOON NEAR A SURFACE BOUNDARY/EFFECTIVE WARM FRONT ACROSS PORTIONS OF SOUTHERN ND AND FARTHER SOUTH ACROSS PORTIONS OF CENTRAL/NORTHERN SD. STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SUPPORT A LARGE HAIL THREAT AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE. WITH TIME...UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS IS LIKELY WITH A MORE CONCENTRATED DAMAGING WIND THREAT. CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED AND A WATCH IS LIKELY PRIOR TO 19Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON OVER PARTS OF SOUTH-CENTRAL AND SOUTHEAST MT. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE. A WATCH MAY BECOME NECESSARY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS CU/TCU FORMING OVER THE MOUNTAINS OF NORTHWEST WY AND SOUTH-CENTRAL MT. THIS IS JUST AHEAD OF A MID-LEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH ROTATING ACROSS ID INTO WESTERN MT. RATHER STRONG WESTERLY FLOW ALOFT IS ASSOCIATED WITH THIS TROUGH...WITH MID-UPPER LEVEL WIND SPEEDS OF 50-70 KNOTS DEPICTED ON AFTERNOON FORECAST SOUNDINGS. THE BLX VAD SHOWS LIGHT NORTHERLY LOW LEVEL WINDS ROUGHLY 2KM DEEP...RESULTING IN UPSLOPE FLOW OF 50+ F SURFACE DEWPOINTS INTO THE REGION. CURRENT INDICATIONS ARE THAT SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS WILL FORM OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN AND SPREAD EASTWARD THIS AFTERNOON. PARAMETERS ARE FAVORABLE FOR A FEW SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: MULTIPLE CLUSTERS OF STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ARE AFFECTING THE WW 390 REGION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TWO CLUSTERS OF INTENSE THUNDERSTORMS CONTINUE TO AFFECT THIS REGION. ONE CLUSTER IS OVER KIDDER/STUTSMAN COUNTIES IN CENTRAL ND...WITH THE SECOND GROUP OF STORMS OVER EDMUNDS/BROWN COUNTIES OF NORTHEAST SD. BOTH GROUPS OF STORMS HAVE PRODUCED GUSTY WINDS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL. IT REMAINS LIKELY THAT ACTIVITY IN THIS REGION WILL GROW UPSCALE THIS AFTERNOON...WITH AN INCREASING RISK OF DENSER COVERAGE OF DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL. OTHER STORMS HAVE BEGUN TO FORM ALONG A FLANKING SURFACE BOUNDARY OVER NORTHWEST SD...AND OVER THE BLACK HILLS. THIS ACTIVITY WILL TRACK EASTWARD AND EVENTUALLY INTO WW 390. A NEW WW IS BEING CONSIDERED FOR PARTS OF WESTERN SD INTO MT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR STRONG TO ISOLATED SEVERE WIND GUSTS ALONG WITH LARGE HAIL SHOULD DEVELOP EAST/SOUTH OF WW/S 390/391. REPLACEMENT OF WW 390 WITH A DOWNSTREAM WATCH ISSUANCE IS EXPECTED BY 00Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SMALL CLUSTER OF STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE STORMS RESPONSIBLE FOR PRODUCING MULTIPLE MEASURED SEVERE WIND GUSTS OVER THE PAST COUPLE HOURS CONTINUES TO PROGRESS EAST AT AROUND 35 KT OVER NORTHEAST SD. LARGER STORM CLUSTERS ARE ONGOING FROM SOUTHEAST MT ACROSS NORTHEAST WY AND ALONG A SURFACE TROUGH OVER SOUTH-CENTRAL ND INTO NORTH-CENTRAL SD. AS A SOUTH-SOUTHWESTERLY LLJ INTENSIFIES THIS EVENING ACROSS THE CENTRAL PLAINS TO SIOUXLAND...ADDITIONAL STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO FORM IN BETWEEN THESE CLUSTERS NEAR THE SURFACE WARM FRONT CURRENTLY ARCING ACROSS CENTRAL TO SOUTHEAST SD INTO CENTRAL IA. THIS ROBUST LOW-LEVEL WAA REGIME AMID 40-50 KT MID-LEVEL WESTERLIES WILL REMAIN FAVORABLE FOR ORGANIZED CLUSTERS AND EMBEDDED SUPERCELL STRUCTURES WITH PRIMARY HAZARDS OF SEVERE WIND/HAIL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE WIND/HAIL MAY PERSIST EASTWARD AS AN MCS SHIFTS FROM WESTERN INTO CENTRAL SD. PORTIONS OF WW 391 MAY REQUIRE AN AREAL EXTENSION EAST ACROSS FAR SOUTH-CENTRAL SD.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN MCS WITH EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS IS ONGOING FROM BUTTE TO OGLALA LAKOTA COUNTIES. RAPID CITY VWP DATA SAMPLED STRONG TROPOSPHERIC SPEED SHEAR YIELDING AN ELONGATED STRAIGHT-LINE HODOGRAPH. ALTHOUGH THERE IS UNCERTAINTY IN THE DEGREE OF DOWNSTREAM MLCIN OVER CENTRAL SD /WHICH SHOULD FURTHER INCREASE AFTER SUNSET/...THE DEGREE OF DEEP SHEAR AND NUMBER OF STORMS MAY SUPPORT AN ORGANIZED CLUSTER CONTINUING EAST EVENTUALLY INTO PARTS OF WW 392. A MIX OF SEVERE WIND/HAIL IS ANTICIPATED. ..GRAMS.. 07/17/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ONGOING SEVERE STORM CLUSTERS FROM EAST-CENTRAL SD TO SOUTHWEST MN WILL LIKELY MERGE INTO A BROADER CLUSTER THAT SHOULD PROPAGATE SOUTHEASTWARD TOWARDS NORTHERN IA. DOWNSTREAM WW ISSUANCE MAY BE NECESSARY BY 03-04Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LEAD STORM CLUSTER WITH A HISTORY OF MEASURED SEVERE WINDS IS PROGRESSING SOUTHEAST ALONG THE MN RIVER VALLEY...WHILE A SLOWER-MOVING SUPERCELL HAS PERSISTED ACROSS CLARK COUNTY SD WITH A HISTORY OF LARGE HAIL AND A BRIEF TORNADO. CONVECTION IS INCREASING BETWEEN THESE AREAS AS WELL AS SOUTHWARD ALONG THE MN/SD BORDER WITHIN A 40-KT LLJ PER FSD VWP DATA. THIS LOW-LEVEL WAA REGIME SHOULD FOSTER FURTHER CLUSTERING INTO A BROADER MCS AS INDIVIDUAL UPDRAFTS AMALGAMATE. THIS MCS WILL LIKELY EVOLVE SOUTHEAST ALONG THE CAPE GRADIENT EVIDENT IN OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS...AND SHOULD RESULT IN A PRIMARY RISK OF SEVERE WIND DEVELOPING INTO PARTS OF NORTHERN IA AND PERHAPS SOUTHEAST MN.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORM CLUSTER OVER NORTH-CENTRAL SD WITH A HISTORY OF SEVERAL SEVERE WIND GUSTS SHOULD BEGIN TO WEAKEN AS IT MOVES EAST INTO A LESS UNSTABLE AIR MASS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORM CLUSTER THAT HAS PRODUCED SEVERAL SEVERE WIND GUSTS OVER NORTH-CENTRAL SD WILL BE PROGRESSING EAST OF AN OCCLUDING WARM SECTOR DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. LOW-LEVEL AIR MASS ACROSS NORTHEAST SD TOWARDS THE UPPER RED RIVER VALLEY HAS LIKELY BEEN STABILIZED BY AN ONGOING MCS THAT IS SHIFTING SOUTH/SOUTHEAST ACROSS EAST-CENTRAL SD AND SOUTHWEST MN. WHILE FORWARD MOMENTUM WILL PROBABLY SUPPORT SOME RISK FOR SEVERE WIND GUSTS THROUGH ABOUT 06Z...WEAKNESSES IN THE MID-LEVEL HODOGRAPH EVIDENT IN ABR VWP DATA ALONG WITH THE LESS FAVORABLE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT SUGGEST THIS RISK SHOULD BE IN A DECREASING STATE. ..GRAMS.. 07/17/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE WIND AND HAIL AS WELL AS HEAVY RAIN REMAIN POSSIBLE THIS MORNING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TWO SEPARATE MCS/S HAVE MERGED OVER NWRN IA WHERE SOME STRONGER CORES HAVE BEEN NOTED RECENTLY. THIS IS ALSO WHERE THE STRONGEST LIFT IS OCCURRING IN PROXIMITY TO MERGING OUTFLOWS AND NEAR THE SFC WARM FRONT. MEASURED WIND GUSTS OVER SERN SD INTO NWRN IA HAVE GENERALLY BEEN IN THE 30-40 KT RANGE OVER THE PAST FEW HOURS. THIS GENERAL MAGNITUDE OF WIND MAY PERSIST FOR SEVERAL HOURS AS THE MCS PROGRESSES ESEWD AIDED BY A SWLY 850 MB JET WHICH WILL CONTINUE TO ADVECT A RELATIVELY WARM AND UNSTABLE AIR MASS AHEAD OF THE SYSTEM. VERY HEAVY RAIN WILL CONTINUE TO BE A THREAT AS WELL ESPECIALLY WITH THE NRN IA LEADING LINE WHICH IS ORIENTED W-E.
